plaatsen.tekst: And she said, As the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
